name: Alpic
description: Deploys, hosts, monitors, and debugs MCP servers on an MCP-native cloud, with its own MCP server for managing projects, deployments, and analytics.

skills.name: MCP Deployment
skills.description: Deploys an MCP server from source to a managed runtime with transport, scaling, and TLS handled by the platform.

skills.name: Server Monitoring

skills.name: Project Management
skills.description: Manages projects, environments, and deployments through Alpic own MCP server from inside an agent session.
